shortDescription: Manage user tokens on a Proxmox Backup Server

options.name: api_host
options.description: Specify the target host of the Proxmox VE cluster.

options.name: api_password
options.description: Specify the password to authenticate with. You can also use the C(PROXMOX_PASSWORD) environment variable.

options.name: api_user
options.description: Specify the user to authenticate with.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether to enable the token. false means disabled.

options.name: expire
options.description: Token expiration data (seconds since UNIX epoch). 0 means no expiration date

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the token that will be part of the authid. Example: C(token1) results in the authid C(user@pbs!token1)

options.name: state
options.description: C(present) makes sure the user exists, C(absent) makes sure the user is removed.

options.name: userid
options.description: User that the token will be created for. Must be in C(user@realm) format (e.g. C(john@pbs))

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Validate SSL certificate of the PVE host upon connecting
